# ShogunAgent

> The state layer for AI agents. Read what is true about the user's work right now (people, projects, commitments, open loops) with a quote and a confidence score on every fact; write what you learned so the next agent starts from it; run tools through a router that enforces permission tiers. Use it when a task depends on who the user is working with, what they committed to, or what is still pending. Not a transcript store and not a general web-search tool.

The state layer for AI agents: shared people, projects, commitments and open work, with source evidence and approval controls.

Skill version 0.1.0. Check the repository's release status before relying on npm packages, release downloads or a hosted service. The configured hosted MCP URL is https://api.shogunagent.dev/mcp (Streamable HTTP, 2026-07-28); use an operator-confirmed endpoint and credentials. Local setup requires binaries, an existing encrypted store and its matching key. Bare `npx shogunagent@0.1` only serves; installation and MCP connection are explicit steps (see SKILL.md and the CLI guide). Reads of the principal's data are free but require authorization; hosted writes and runs are metered in micro-USD.

## Start here

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/Torutesu/Shogunagent/blob/main/SKILL.md): the skill agents install: when to use it and when not, setup, auth, precedence of facts, cost, what L1 / L2 / L3 mean for the caller, statuses and errors, numbered rules.
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/Torutesu/Shogunagent/blob/main/packages/cli/README.md): existing-store prerequisites, source builds, explicit install/connect commands, local authentication and a synthetic first ingest.
- [Agent API guide](https://github.com/Torutesu/Shogunagent/blob/main/apps/api/README-agent-api.md): The agent-facing half of the gateway: `sa_` keys, a prepaid micro-USD wallet, hard caps, the `402` contract, quotes, receipts, and the metered MCP proxy. Plan: `docs/implementation-plan.md` E3 / E9…
- [README](https://github.com/Torutesu/Shogunagent/blob/main/README.md): what is available today, the local quickstart, connecting an agent, verification and known limits.
- [Strategy](https://github.com/Torutesu/Shogunagent/blob/main/docs/strategy.md): positioning, pricing model, go-to-market and roadmap (direction, not availability).

- [Connector tokens for the router (E48 contract, E50 credentials, E51 Notion and revocation)](https://github.com/Torutesu/Shogunagent/blob/main/docs/api/connector-tokens.md): The router's first-party connectors (Gmail, Google Calendar, GitHub, Linear, Slack, Notion) act as the calling principal's own account at the vendor. Their wire names, input property names and annotations are frozen (CLAUDE.md invariant 11):…

- [Agent payments: mandates and spends](https://github.com/Torutesu/Shogunagent/blob/main/docs/api/payments.md): A payment mandate is a human's pre-approval for one agent to pay within bounds: an exact payee or a payee class, a currency, a maximum per payment, a total cap, an expiry, a purpose and, optionally,…

## Machine-readable surfaces

- [MCP server card](https://api.shogunagent.dev/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): endpoint, auth, the tool list with annotations (readOnlyHint = L1 read; destructiveHint + openWorldHint = L3).
- [A2A agent card](https://api.shogunagent.dev/.well-known/agent-card.json): signed identity, provider, skills, security schemes.
- [Pricing](https://api.shogunagent.dev/.well-known/pricing.json): the rate card, free allowance and caps, from the same table the metering enforces.
- [Status](https://api.shogunagent.dev/.well-known/status.json): live p50 / p95, error rate over five minutes, incident history. [Health](https://api.shogunagent.dev/health) is the short form.
- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://api.shogunagent.dev/openapi.json): the REST face (agents, keys, wallet, quote, receipts, /mcp, router verbs).
- [MCP Registry entry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers/io.github.torutesu%2Fshogunagent): io.github.torutesu/shogunagent.
- [Full documentation in one file](https://api.shogunagent.dev/llms-full.txt)
